note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace (40 mm case, listing; strap 20 mm measured, the listing's 10 mm lug width is wrong). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, sub-dials, moon window and the strap leather come from one photo map.

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the thin sloped bezel (18.92-20 mm in the photo); inner lip covers the dial edge

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

hand_white.note: the photo's hands read bright white; thin polished-steel needles reflected the dark surroundings and disappeared (Irsyad 2026-11-09)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission; black base colour so the dark dial is not hazed in model-viewer
